title: Fair rules
info: A fair rule is the same for everyone in the group.
Taking turns is fair. Changing a rule in the middle so only you win is not.

options: applies the same way to everyone
changes when one friend is losing
a way to skip people you dislike

questions.q: If a rule is confusing, you should
options: ask a teacher or a grown-up
letting only your team touch the ball, against the agreed rules
both teams following the same rules
keep people safe and let everyone learn

questions.q: Type the word for rules that treat people the same.
